description: Profile picture for invoce@ecuanutrition.com - minimalist premium official invoicing avatar, navy gradient + Ecuanutrition logo + gold ledger line + Spanish/English microtype
prompt:
Premium minimalist official email profile picture for the invoicing department of ECUANUTRITION (Ecuadorian aquaculture brand). Square 1024x1024 format optimized for Gmail / Outlook avatar circle crop. Visual identity must communicate trust, formality, financial precision, premium quality — like the avatar of a luxury private bank, a notarial firm, or an executive accounting service. NOT colorful, NOT playful, NOT cartoon.

BACKGROUND: deep navy gradient from hex 1E4670 in the upper-left to hex 2A5478 in the lower-right. Subtle paper-like texture at 5 percent opacity. A faint cyan radial glow centered behind the logo at 15 percent opacity to lift the subject from the background.

CENTERPIECE: the official ECUANUTRITION corporate emblem rendered crisp and centered, occupying about 55 percent of the frame width. The emblem is a tall elegant SERIF letter E (similar to Bodoni/Didone weight, high stroke contrast) embraced by TWO flowing curved lines forming a circular shrimp silhouette around the E:
- The serif letter E rendered in pure WHITE hex FFFFFF.
- The OUTER curve (longer, sweeping from upper-left around the right side and down to lower-right) in a light cyan hex 7AAFD3 with a soft gradient to white at the highlights.
- The INNER curve (shorter, tucked above and inside the E) in a brighter cyan hex 9CC2DC.
- A small filled cyan dot hex 7AAFD3 floating above and to the right of the E (the shrimp's eye).
- The logo glows softly in cyan light, subtle inner halo effect.

GOLD LEDGER LINE: directly under the logo, a thin elegant horizontal line in metallic gold hex F2C744, 1 to 2 pixels thick, full width with soft fade at both ends. Suggests the bottom rule of a financial document.

MICROTYPE LABEL: directly below the gold line, two small labels separated by a centered bullet, in clean modern sans-serif uppercase letters, generously letter-spaced (tracking 200), in metallic gold hex F2C744 at small size (about 5 percent of frame height): FACTURACION middle dot INVOICING.

UPPER-LEFT CORNER: a discreet gold corner ornament — a thin L-shaped bracket in metallic gold hex F2C744, like the corner of a sealed official document or premium certificate. Roughly 7 percent of frame width.

UPPER-RIGHT CORNER: the matching mirrored gold L-bracket on the upper-right corner.

STYLE: ultra-clean vector / 3D hybrid, premium financial branding aesthetic, sharp focus, high contrast, masterfully balanced negative space, subtle atmospheric depth. Reads instantly clear at thumbnail size (40x40 pixels in an inbox list) AND looks luxurious at full resolution. Reject anything cartoonish or playful.

REJECT: shrimp character mascot, cartoon, 3D mascot, multiple logos, busy ornaments, photographic backgrounds, gradients with too many colors, watermarks, signatures, photorealistic textures, faces, characters, currency symbols, dollar signs, percent signs, calculator imagery.

Brand colors per MANUAL_DE_MARCA section 2.3 (Oro Heroico F2C744). Concept: 'el logo recien firmado' — accountancy semantic without cliche dollar/calculator icons.
prompt:
Premium minimalist email profile picture for ECUANUTRITION's invoicing department (invoce@ecuanutrition.com). Square 1024x1024 optimized for Gmail/Outlook avatar circle crop. Visual identity: trust, formality, financial precision, premium — like a luxury private bank or notarial firm avatar. NOT colorful, NOT playful, NOT cartoon. NO Ecuaman shrimp mascot.

CRITICAL — PRESERVE THE INPUT LOGO EXACTLY: the reference image is the OFFICIAL ECUANUTRITION ISOTYPE. Reuse it identically in the center of the composition, occupying about 50 percent of the frame width. Do NOT redraw, do NOT alter, do NOT recolor the serif letter E, the two flowing curved lines forming the shrimp silhouette around the E, or the cyan eye dot. The isotype's typography, proportions, stroke weights and colors must remain pixel-faithful to the reference. The logo is the visual hero. Any modification of the logo is a failure.

BACKGROUND: deep navy gradient from hex 1E4670 (upper-left) to hex 2A5478 (lower-right). Subtle paper-like texture 5 percent opacity. Faint cyan radial glow hex 7AAFD3 at 15 percent opacity centered behind the logo to lift it.

NEW ELEMENT — CLASSICAL GOLD FOUNTAIN PEN NIB (the only addition to the composition):
- A small, elegant, classical fountain pen nib (think Mont Blanc / Pelikan / Parker silhouette) rendered in metallic gold hex F2C744 — the official 'Oro Heroico' from Ecuanutrition's brand manual.
- Position: diagonally placed at the lower-right of the logo, the pen body angled from upper-right to lower-left, the writing tip pointing toward the lower-left as if it has just finished signing.
- Size: pen length about 22 percent of frame width, pen width about 4 percent of frame width.
- Detail: include the classic central breather hole on the nib, a subtle gold-on-gold engraved tip line, and a soft inner highlight along the pen's spine for premium specular feel. No brand name on the pen.
- The pen's writing tip touches the right end of a thin gold horizontal line directly beneath the logo — the line appears to have just been drawn BY the pen, like a freshly signed signature stroke.

GOLD SIGNATURE LINE: directly under the isotype, a thin elegant horizontal line in metallic gold hex F2C744, 1 to 2 pixels thick, with a soft fade at the LEFT end and a clean stop at the RIGHT end exactly where the pen tip rests. Reads as 'just signed by the pen above'.

MICROTYPE LABEL below the gold line: two short labels separated by a centered small gold bullet, in clean modern uppercase sans-serif (Montserrat-like or Bank Gothic-like), generously letter-spaced (tracking 200), in metallic gold hex F2C744, at about 5 percent of frame height. EXACT TEXT spelled carefully — no doubled letters: F-A-C-T-U-R-A-C-I-O-N then a small middle-dot bullet then I-N-V-O-I-C-I-N-G. The Spanish word is FACTURACION (eleven letters total), the English word is INVOICING (nine letters). Render each letter once and only once.

CORNER ORNAMENTS: thin L-shaped brackets in metallic gold hex F2C744 in the upper-left and upper-right corners only, mirrored, about 7 percent of frame width. Like the corner of a sealed official document. Lower corners stay clean.

PALETTE — strictly Ecuanutrition brand (per MANUAL_DE_MARCA_ECUAMAN section 2):
- Background navy gradient: 1E4670 to 2A5478
- Gold (pen, signature line, microtype, corner brackets): F2C744 (Oro Heroico)
- Cyan halo behind logo: 7AAFD3
- Logo colors: untouched, exactly as reference image
- Pure white FFFFFF only as tiny specular highlights on the pen nib
No other colors. No greens, no reds, no oranges.

STYLE: ultra-clean vector / 3D hybrid, premium financial branding aesthetic, sharp focus, high contrast, masterfully balanced negative space, subtle atmospheric depth. Reads instantly clear at thumbnail size (40x40 pixels in an inbox list) AND looks luxurious at full resolution.

REJECT: any modification of the input logo's letter E or its curves or its eye dot, multiple pens, ink splatters, dollar signs, currency symbols, percent signs, calculator imagery, ledger numbers, charts, photographic backgrounds, gradients with extra colors, watermarks, human signatures, photorealistic paper textures, faces, characters, the shrimp mascot Ecuaman, the cape or trident, busy ornaments, doubled or tripled letters in the text, the misspelling FACTURACIOION, lower-case letters in the microtype, ribbons, banners, scrolls, stamps, seals over the logo.
